svg.title: Change materiality: from three answers to a path
svg.desc: The risk class, the process impact and the process criticality give a change materiality of Minor, Medium or Significant; adjustments can raise it; the materiality decides the path. Six worked examples.
svg.text: CHANGE MATERIALITY: FROM THREE ANSWERS TO A PATH
Rated at Gate 1, and again on every substantial modification or new use. It rates full-track assets and their uses; components are assessed by their class.
